source: T-680 (handoff/tickets/T-680-ni-act-complaint-quality.md) at the extraction step only; the limitation warning and the s.142 pleading are draft-level and not exercised here. Ajay T-683 rule 1 (P3 amounts, ambiguous date gives no fact), Arjun T-683 answers section 5. description: Notice under section 138 of the NI Act for the payee Sample Person 1 against the drawer Sample Person 2 (an individual). Cheque no. 000123 dated 10.07.2026 for teen lakh rupees drawn on Sample Bank, Sample Branch was presented on 15.07.2026 and returned unpaid on 17.07.2026 for insufficient funds. The return memo was received on 20/7/26. The notice was sent on 23.08.2026.

ledger.why: 20/7/26 has a two-digit year: ambiguous, no fact
